caveat: This ledger records the pass order and the yield of each lane from the pages actually captured on 2026-11-24. It is not a timestamped replay of the browsing session; a failed or refused fetch is logged as failed and is never counted as a completed check. A lane with no captured page is recorded with pages_read 0 and a zero yield.
